summary_en: 32,000,000 shares (20.78% of outstanding), ¥156,768M upper limit, ToSTNeT-3 acquisition from 10 Aug 2026, cancellation of all acquired shares except 150,000 planned for 30 Sept 2026.
title_en: Notice of Authorization for Treasury Share Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Toyo Tire's board of directors authorized a treasury share acquisition framework under Company Law Article 165(3) (as applied per Article 156), and also authorized cancellation of treasury shares under Article 178. The board resolved to acquire up to 32,000,000 ordinary shares (20.78% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥156,768 million. Acquisition will commence on 10 August 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange) trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Concurrent with the acquisition authorization, the board resolved to cancel all acquired shares except 150,000, scheduled for 30 September 2026. The rationale stated is alignment with the mid-term business plan 'Mid-plan 26', which prioritizes capital efficiency improvement and enhanced shareholder returns. As of 7 August 2026, the company held 99,126 treasury shares, and there were 154,011,903 shares outstanding excluding treasury.
